issues.description: Method signature inconsistency for `addGuestStudents`: the problem statement and UML specify `addGuestStudents(int, String)` (adds guest students with a reason), but the reference solution implements `addGuestStudents(int)` without the required `String reason` parameter. This mismatch makes the expected API unclear and would cause student implementations following the statement/UML to differ from the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts on one signature. Preferred: change the solution (and intended student implementation/tests) to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason)`; the method may ignore `reason` if not otherwise required, but must accept it to match the specification/UML.
